- Walk through the Node/Python SDK quickstart and run a sample generation request

Hi Rachel — so sorry, our side is completely tied up. Our SRE team had a pager storm and the whole integration group is on a call that ran long. Apologies for the short notice.

We weren't able to join. Also, I couldn't find the API keys in our dashboard (I checked the account dropdown). Could you point me to exactly where keys are provisioned, or send the temporary key rotation steps? We're eager to get the SDK running but can't spare heads for a live session today.

Can we pick two reschedule slots next week? Wednesday or Friday mornings PT would work. If not, an async checklist + a short recorded run-through would be great.

—Sarah
Sarah Lee
Director of Integrations, Novacrete
sarah.lee@novacrete.com | 617-555-0123
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@novacrete.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 10:27:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Novacrete trial onboarding — 6/12 10:00 PT integration kickoff

Hi Sarah — sorry you got pulled into the pager incident. Quick triage notes below so you can make progress without a live meeting: 

1) Where keys live
- In the Console: Team menu > Settings > API Keys. Keys are scoped by project; use the test project we created for Novacrete: project_id=novacrete-test-001.
- If you don't see the Test project, your user may not be in the project. I can add integrations@novacrete.com now if you confirm the primary email list.

2) Temporary rotation / lockbox option (short-term)
- We can generate a temporary key and push it to our secure lockbox for you to fetch. This avoids sending keys over email.
- Attached: api-key-rotation.pdf — step-by-step for both the Console flow and lockbox retrieval.

3) Async SDK run command (Node) — one-liner to validate connectivity:

  1) npm i @redwood/inference
  2) export REDWOOD_API_KEY=<your-temp-key>
  3) node -e "const RW = require('@redwood/inference'); (async ()=>{const c=new RW.Client(); console.log(await c.generate({model:'redwood-small',prompt:'hello'}))})()"

4) Troubleshooting checklist (quick): network egress allowed to api.redwood.ai, workspace membership, and that the account has trial tokens. If you hit 403, message me the request-id header and I'll check logs.

5) Reschedule options I can offer (PT):
- Wed 2026-06-16 09:30 — 10:00
- Wed 2026-06-16 11:00 — 11:30
- Fri 2026-06-18 08:30 — 09:00

If you'd rather we proceed asynchronously I can:
- Add integrations@novacrete.com to the Test project now,
- Generate a single-use key in the lockbox and post retrieval link,
- Record a 7-minute screen capture of the Node quickstart and drop it in Drive.

Let me know what you prefer and I'll action immediately.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Support Engineer, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0999

Attachments: api-key-rotation.pdf
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Novacrete trial onboarding — missed kickoff and async integration plan

Hi Sarah — following up to lock this in and give an async option so you can keep momentum.

What we did for you: 
- Added integrations@novacrete.com to the Novacrete Test project (you should see project_id=novacrete-test-001 in Console)
- Generated a temporary single-use key and placed it in our secure lockbox: retrieval link (expires 48h): https://redwood.lockbox/retrieve/abc123
- Uploaded a 7-minute screen capture and the async starter kit to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/novacrete-onboarding-notes
- Attached a small zip with example curl and SDK commands: async-starter-kit.zip

If you want a live reschedule, my preference is Wednesday 6/16 11:00 PT. Monica will join for a short SDK walkthrough and Vivek can do any troubleshooting. If that doesn't work, pick any 2 slots from Vivek's list and we'll confirm.

If you hit any 403/404 or the lockbox link fails, reply with the error and request-id and we'll escalate immediately.

Thanks for the quick note earlier — hope the pager storm eased.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
